# teams_meeting_broadcast_policy (Resource)

Manages the MeetingBroadcastPolicy policy via New-CsTeamsMeetingBroadcastPolicy / Get-CsTeamsMeetingBroadcastPolicy / Set-CsTeamsMeetingBroadcastPolicy / Remove-CsTeamsMeetingBroadcastPolicy.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Name (Identity) of the object; also the create key. Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `allow_broadcast_scheduling` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowBroadcastScheduling parameter.
- `allow_broadcast_transcription` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowBroadcastTranscription parameter.
- `broadcast_attendee_visibility_mode` (String) Maps to the -BroadcastAttendeeVisibilityMode parameter.
- `broadcast_recording_mode` (String) Maps to the -BroadcastRecordingMode parameter.
- `description` (String) Maps to the -Description parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
